task.instruction: Find the opening hours of the Hong Kong Museum of Art

subtasks.goal: The opening hours of the Hong Kong Museum of Art are visible on screen, from an official or reliable source.

values.name: search
values.text: Hong Kong Museum of Art opening hours

answer: According to a search result from worldmuseumguide.org, the Hong Kong Museum of Art is open Monday to Wednesday and Friday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Saturday and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM. It is closed on Thursdays. Another site, tripinfohub.com, also lists 10:00-18:00 and closed Thursdays. Both are third-party sites, so the official page (hk.art.museum/en/web/ma/visit/opening-hours-and-admission.html) would be the best place to confirm, but its snippet does not show the hours.
evidence: worldmuseumguide.org: "Open Monday to Wednesday, Friday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday to Sunday: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM (Closed Thursdays)." tripinfohub.com: "10:00-18:00 (Closed on Thursdays)."
